artifacts.delta_brief: Between 2023 and 2024, NVDA continues to emphasize artificial_intelligence and manufacturing as core risk exposure (2023 para 155; 2024 para 126). The earlier filing is relatively more anchored in artificial_intelligence, while the later filing adds clearer weight to manufacturing (2023 para 174; 2024 para 51). Across both years, management frames these items as operational and financial execution pressures rather than isolated one-off events (2023 para 155; 2024 para 51). This comparison should be read as directional because the lens is a focuspack subset and not the full Item 1A text (2023 para 174; 2024 para 126). Overall, the narrative indicates continuity with selective shifts in emphasis instead of a full thematic reset (2023 para 155; 2024 para 126).
